decisions.reason: After four years on market and no signs of failure, uncertainty about the semi-hard cheese has largely resolved, and keeping the option open is low-cost while it complements the established range.
The spicy cheese line has several models that still hold option value through variety, and its continued presence since 2018 does not indicate value is unlikely.
The mild creamy soft cheese is close to the established soft cheese offer and has shown enough durability to justify keeping the option at little cost.
